articles.title: Weekly Stock List
articles.summary: Argus Research: Weekly Stock List. Argus is hosting a five-part webinar series on AI, examining the ways that different sectors are incorporating AI practices. We recently completed our third webinar, featuring the Financial sector. AI is helping Financial companies become leaner, more efficient, and more service/customer focused. Financial sector companies tend to be big spenders on technology and have been early leaders in adopting AI practices. There are many ways these companies use AI strategies, including in back-office processes, fraud detection, compliance, improved customer service, marketing, or for completing mundane or repetitive tasks (like reading or analyzing data). Banks, brokerages, payment processors, insurance companies are some of the industries within the overall sector. For our list this week, we've put together a cheat sheet from our recent webinar, highlighting some of our BUY-rated Financial sector companies that are taking the lead in the use of AI. Related tickers mentioned: BK-PK, CB, ICE, JPM, MS, MS-PQ, SPGI, TRV, V, XYZ.
